writeup.headline: Xometry rates Buy on fast, accelerating growth and strong price trend, with losses and valuation gaps unresolved.
writeup.thesis: Xometry scores 68, a Buy, carried mainly by growth (91) and trend (90). Latest-quarter revenue growth of 41.0% year on year and TTM revenue growth of 33.8% are strong, and growth sped up by 5.2 pp from the previous quarter. The shares are up 106.7% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago and are 111.2 pp ahead of SPY over the last 126 trading days. Quality is weaker at 42: gross margin is 38.8%, but operating margin is -3.8%, stock-based pay is 5.0% of revenue, and the diluted share count is up 2.4% year on year. News risk is neutral at 50. Balance sheet and valuation could not be scored, so the rating rests on the other four factors.
key_risks: The company is still unprofitable at the operating level, with an operating margin of -3.8%.
P/S of 5.7 is high in absolute terms and is more expensive than at 43 of the last 51 month-ends.
After a large run, the price is 31.9% above its 200-day average, so a growth miss could hit the shares hard.
Q3 results on 2026-11-03 must meet guidance of $234-$236 million revenue and full-year growth of 33-34%.
Ongoing dilution from stock-based pay, with the diluted share count up 2.4% year on year.
what_would_change: A drop of 4 points would move the rating to Hold. Slowing revenue growth or a fading price trend could do that.
A rise of 12 points would reach Strong Buy. That would likely need better quality scores, such as a move to positive operating margin.
Q3 results or a guidance change on 2026-11-03 could shift the news risk score in either direction.
